crypto_published_justification: Owned HCL and Python/shell validation helpers do not implement a cipher, key exchange, password verifier or RNG. GitHub communication is delegated to the integrations/github provider and, where present, gh; ordinary provider configuration does not override TLS verification or select a weak cipher. https://github.com/4alvit/terraform-github-open-ott-play/blob/655247d0c11c01211dab48a22833fca76ed38553/main.tf https://github.com/4alvit/terraform-github-open-ott-play/blob/655247d0c11c01211dab48a22833fca76ed38553/SECURITY.md
crypto_call_justification: Cryptographic operations are delegated to dedicated standard implementations; no owned cryptographic primitive implementation was found in tracked production sources. https://github.com/4alvit/terraform-github-open-ott-play/blob/655247d0c11c01211dab48a22833fca76ed38553/main.tf https://github.com/4alvit/terraform-github-open-ott-play/blob/655247d0c11c01211dab48a22833fca76ed38553/SECURITY.md
crypto_floss_justification: The cryptographic implementation used by the GitHub provider is FLOSS: its verified transport uses Go crypto/TLS. The provider is MIT licensed. This claim concerns cryptographic functionality, not the separate licensing of the Terraform CLI or hosted services. https://github.com/4alvit/terraform-github-open-ott-play/blob/655247d0c11c01211dab48a22833fca76ed38553/main.tf https://github.com/4alvit/terraform-github-open-ott-play/blob/655247d0c11c01211dab48a22833fca76ed38553/SECURITY.md
crypto_keylength_justification: No project-defined default key size exists to audit. The source delegates TLS to external clients and receives authentication/signing material from operators. Do not substitute the presence of HTTPS for verification of all default key sizes and the ability to disable smaller sizes. https://github.com/4alvit/terraform-github-open-ott-play/blob/655247d0c11c01211dab48a22833fca76ed38553/main.tf https://github.com/4alvit/terraform-github-open-ott-play/blob/655247d0c11c01211dab48a22833fca76ed38553/SECURITY.md Document the supported client/crypto baseline and minimum permitted signing/webhook key sizes, or justify narrower applicability after reviewing all externally supplied key paths.
crypto_working_justification: No default owned security operation uses MD4, MD5, DES, RC4 or another broken primitive. Network and signing crypto are delegated to maintained standard clients; no source TLS-verification bypass was found. https://github.com/4alvit/terraform-github-open-ott-play/blob/655247d0c11c01211dab48a22833fca76ed38553/main.tf https://github.com/4alvit/terraform-github-open-ott-play/blob/655247d0c11c01211dab48a22833fca76ed38553/SECURITY.md
crypto_weaknesses_justification: No owned use of SHA1 or a weak cipher was found. Provider HTTPS is used with its normal verified-TLS defaults; cryptographic algorithms are not reimplemented in the HCL/helpers. https://github.com/4alvit/terraform-github-open-ott-play/blob/655247d0c11c01211dab48a22833fca76ed38553/main.tf https://github.com/4alvit/terraform-github-open-ott-play/blob/655247d0c11c01211dab48a22833fca76ed38553/SECURITY.md
crypto_pfs_justification: The project does not implement its own key agreement. The supported Go TLS implementation offers ephemeral key exchange, but this audit did not establish the complete deployed client/endpoint and signing transport configuration. Keep this suggested criterion unknown until that baseline is documented; do not mark N/A solely because transport is delegated. https://github.com/4alvit/terraform-github-open-ott-play/blob/655247d0c11c01211dab48a22833fca76ed38553/main.tf https://github.com/4alvit/terraform-github-open-ott-play/blob/655247d0c11c01211dab48a22833fca76ed38553/SECURITY.md
crypto_password_storage_justification: There is no authentication database of passwords for external users in the owned source. Operator GitHub tokens, webhook shared secrets and signing keys are credentials passed to external services, not stored external-user password verifiers. https://github.com/4alvit/terraform-github-open-ott-play/blob/655247d0c11c01211dab48a22833fca76ed38553/main.tf https://github.com/4alvit/terraform-github-open-ott-play/blob/655247d0c11c01211dab48a22833fca76ed38553/SECURITY.md
crypto_random_justification: The owned configuration and helper code does not generate cryptographic keys or nonces.
